integrity.analytic_basis: A trace-one two-dimensional projector identity and an all-real completed square determine the exact eigenvalue and unique optimizer.
integrity.priority_risk: Equivalent unindexed special-case derivations may exist; no priority certification is asserted.
integrity.reproducible_checks: verify.py performs 1152 deterministic exact-rational checks; these are supplementary, not a replacement for proof.

scientific_limitations: Exactly two real dimensions, invertible matrix with unequal singular values, one Euclidean projection per iid nonzero sketch.
Optimizes a specified Bernoulli-sign sparse/dense mixture over its density, not all sketch distributions or computational wall time.
Optimal tuning requires knowledge of right singular-vector orientation; no higher-dimensional guarantee is established.
The proved contraction parameter is worst-case uniform over initial errors and times, not a claim about every fixed initial error having the same exact asymptotic exponent.
title: An exact orientation-only optimal sparsity law for planar sketch-and-project
